name: io.github.ahmad-codex/purser
title: Purser
description: Wallet for AI agents with on-chain spending limits and owner approval over the limit

environmentVariables.name: PURSER_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: JSON-RPC URL of the chain the account is on

environmentVariables.name: PURSER_ACCOUNT
environmentVariables.description: Address of the Purser smart account

environmentVariables.name: PURSER_AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The agent's session key. The server never needs the owner key.

environmentVariables.name: PURSER_BUNDLER_URL
environmentVariables.description: ERC-4337 bundler URL. Without one, the relayer key submits handleOps itself.

environmentVariables.name: PURSER_RELAYER_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Pays for handleOps when there is no bundler. Defaults to the agent key.

environmentVariables.name: PURSER_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for the approvals API and console
